conviction_note: A Q1 print with no forecast revision and no shareholder return expected (this company has only ever revised in Feb-Apr and announces buybacks/dividend changes in March-April; the current 200m-yen buyback runs to 2027-03-31). The two sourced facts that bear on the quarter, a consulting backlog down 7.7% y/y offset by a doubled lumpy 業務代行 backlog, and an unusually low prior-year Q1 base, point in opposite directions and are both public in the July 短信, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. impact_sum is +0.1, the same story: nothing the price does not hold.
bar: No consensus exists (no IFIS/四季報 number found; kabuyoho shows no analyst forecast; Yahoo earningsHistory has no estimate). No H1 or Q1 company guide. The only bar is the FY2027/5 company plan (sales 17,500m, OP 2,050m, ordinary 2,100m) from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589968.pdf, read pro rata on this company's own Q1 progress history (OP 274 = 14.2% of FY25; 175 = 8.9% of FY26, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9765) and on the year-ago Q1 headline (OP 175m, ordinary 184m). The bar is weak, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 19.37x on 10/02: margin sell 3.5k shares vs margin buy 67.8k shares (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9765), down from 78.7k long on 09/25. With ~13-15k shares/day of turnover, the margin long is about five days' volume: a crowded leveraged long that has already been reducing, and the stock is -3.9% over 5 sessions into the print. No option skew exists. The baseline lean (-0.58) already carries the margin overhang.

findings.finding: The company enters FY2027/5 with its core construction-consulting backlog down 7.7% y/y (8,047m vs 8,717m: 設計 -18.6%, まちづくり -9.0%, 環境 -13.3%, 地理空間 +10.0%), while the lumpy 事業ソリューション (区画整理 業務代行) backlog doubled to 1,537m (207.4%), so total backlog is only +1.3% (9,584m) and Q1 revenue depends on when 業務代行 income is recognised. Last year that line alone swung Q1 sales from 3,959m to 2,944m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 headline swings driven by 業務代行 timing moved the stock on the release: 2024-10-10 (Q1 OP +860% on 1,387m of 業務代行 sales) +2.57% next session; 2025-10-09 (Q1 OP -36%, 業務代行 sales 215m) -3.82% next session, kabutan headline 'オオバは安い、６～８月期減収減益' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9765&b=n202510100552). Closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9765.T?range=3y&interval=1d.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced: the backlog table is in the full-year 短信 and has been public for three months, and the FY plan (+2.9% sales, +4.3% OP) was set knowing it. What is unpriced is only the Q1 timing of the 業務代行 recognition, which no public series shows. If the market were pricing a weak Q1 the margin long would have unwound harder than 78.7k to 67.8k shares, and the stock would be well below the 1,150-1,210 range it has held for a month; neither is visible.
findings.independence: The year-ago Q1 short (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251009/140120251008570110.pdf) shows the same mechanism: consulting Q1 sales rose 6% (2,571m to 2,728m) and GP margin rose to 33.6%, while 業務代行 fell from 1,387m to 215m. Same company, different document; it explains the mechanism rather than adding a second signal.

findings.finding: The year-ago Q1 is an unusually low base: OP 175m was 8.9% of that year's full-year OP against 14.2% the year before, and consulting GP margin has been rising (33.6% Q1 FY26, 34.4% full-year FY26), so a return to even an average Q1 progress rate (~11-12% of the 2,050m plan, ~230-245m) prints as a 30%+ y/y OP rise in kabutan's headline, which is what this retail-heavy register reads.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two Q1 headline readings in the record moved the stock in the direction of the y/y headline: +2.57% (2024-10-10, OP +860%) and -3.82% (2025-10-09, OP -36%). Closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9765.T?range=3y&interval=1d.
findings.why_not_priced: Anyone can compute the easy comparison from last year's 短信, so it is at most partly unpriced; what the price cannot hold is whether the y/y headline actually prints positive, because the 業務代行 timing (finding 1) can sink it. If an easy comp were being bought, the stock would not be -3.9% over five sessions with the margin long still being reduced.
findings.independence: FY2026 full-year short (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589968.pdf): consulting GP margin up from 33.2% to 34.4% for the year. Partly shares a document with finding 1; it bears on margin, finding 1 on revenue.

Quarter vs own 進捗率: the year-ago Q1 OP was 8.9% of FY against 14.2% the year before, an easy base, against a consulting backlog down 7.7% and a doubled lumpy 業務代行 backlog whose timing decides the headline.
baseline_tension: Neither finding agrees or disagrees much with the baseline: the lean (-0.58, from a 19.4x margin ratio) and the -3.9% five-day run-in lean mildly negative, and the evidence is balanced. The strongest positive the release could carry is a positive y/y Q1 headline on an easy base with the plan held (looked for it; it is finding 2); a buyback top-up or dividend change would break this company's March-April habit, and I found no sign of one.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the backlog finding rests on the July 短信 backlog table, so it was cut from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up moved from 48 to 50

Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for it (easy comp, held plan, buyback); the slight negative lean in the draft came from the margin ratio the baseline already carries, so it was removed; scaled number moved from -0.09 to 0.0
